summary: Highlander Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, reporting the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held June 25, 2026. The filing is a routine report of foreign private issuer voting outcomes under Canadian securities law, corresponding to a US Form 8-K Item 5.07. All director nominees were elected and the auditor was appointed with overwhelming shareholder support. This is a routine current report with no special-situation event such as acquisitions, activist campaigns, or management changes. No deal terms apply.
